Mr. Md. Naser Uddin Chowdhury, Advocate, instructed by Mr. Chowdhury Md. Zahangir, Advocate-on-Record ----- For the Petitioners. 
Mrs. Sufia Khatun, Advocate-on-Record ----- For Respondent No 1. Respondent Nos. 2-3 Not represented.
parties:
Most. Amena Khatun and others
Vs.
Shuja Nagar Shashan Committee, represented by its secretary Sri Kumaresh Kumar Odhikari and others
full_judgment: 2. Facts of the case, in brief, are that the respondent as plaintiff instituted Other Class Suit No 13 of 1984 in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Sujanagar, Pabna, for declaration of title and for recovery of khas possession of the Suit property measuring .20 acre of land under plot No. 633 appertaining to C.S. Khatian No. 4, S.A. Khatian No. 275 of Mouja Sufanagar, stating, inter alia, that the suit property originally belonged to ex-landlord Tara Gobinda Chowdhury and others and they possessed the same as it was under their khas possession. Being approached by the Hindu Community for using the suit property as cremation ground, the ex-landlords approved their proposal and consequently allowed them to create a cremation ground thereon and, thereafter, the suit property has been used as cremation ground by the local Hindu Community and for the aforesaid reason an Ekrarnama dated 22.03.1947 was executed by the ex-landlords in respect of the suit property and its possession was delivered to the plaintiff committee and since then the plaintiff committee has been using the suit property as cremation ground for more than 12 years within the knowledge of all including the defendants. The ex-landlords never settled the suit property to anybody. The cremations on file suit property has been managed by the local Hindu Community through a committee and the plaintiff being Secretary of the committee instituted the above suit. S.A. record was wrongly prepared in the name of defendant No. 2. Defendant No. 1 being purchaser from defendant No. 2 claimed his title over the suit property in the month of Baishakh, 1983 and denied the title of the plaintiff. The plaintiff was not aware of the wrong S.A. record and deed of purchase of defendant No. 1. During S.A. survey, the Survey Officer told the plaintiff that the suit land would be recorded as Government khan land showing possession of the Committee with remarks for public use. Subsequently, defendant No. 3 son of defendant No. 1 in the year 1982 dispossessed the plaintiff and an allegation was filed before the S.D.O. Sadar, Pabna. Hence, the plaintiff Committee represented by its Secretary filed the suit.
